scope: Independent read-only source/spec/numeric/lifecycle review; no compile/simulation launched by this reviewer; not parent acceptance or official signoff.

findings.issue: frontend_cycles starts only in LOAD after BEGIN retirement, so it omits the initial accepted-BEGIN ingress latency.
findings.consequence: The counter cannot be labeled the complete cold frontend window from first accepted task event to final output fire. With timestamp-difference convention it is one cycle shorter than that window; inclusive-edge convention differs by two.
findings.recommendation: Add passive TB timestamps for first BEGIN acceptance, START retirement and final output fire; publish exact timestamp-delta windows separately from state partition counters.

findings.issue: Existing inspected production receipt hashes are 30525506... for optimized RTL and 6388f87f... for TB, while inspected current files have changed.
findings.consequence: Historical receipt is not final-source proof, even if changes were conditional mutation instrumentation.
findings.recommendation: Rerun applicable final-source regression under new IDs and make gate reject stale sources/configs.

checked_invariants.name: synchronous_RAM_and_tag_latency
checked_invariants.result: Source reasoning supports L1 and L2: tag valid/identity shift matches frozen RAM output-valid/data shift.

checked_invariants.name: X_hold_CTX4_recurrence
checked_invariants.result: Each k issues g0,g1,g2,g3; returned g0 writes X hold and uses current X directly, subsequent returned groups use prior registered hold. Accumulator recurrence is four clocks, longer than the one-clock product-to-acc feedback.

checked_invariants.name: last_product_and_epilogue_order
checked_invariants.result: FLUSH waits for valid k63/g3 product retirement. Last NBA accumulator write becomes visible before QISSUE accepts the first epilogue sample. No apparent lost-k63 path in normal RTL.

checked_invariants.name: signed_arithmetic_width
checked_invariants.result: Signed16 times signed16 produces signed32, explicitly sign extended to signed48. Bound 64*32768*32768=68719476736 fits exact signed48. Frozen epilogue uses49-bit bias addition,sat48,RNE0..47,sat32 with separate flags.

checked_invariants.name: tail_and_reset
checked_invariants.result: Tail mask gates X reads and product retirement; quantization/output traverse only effective_rows. Reset clears state/tag/product/q-valid; stale RAM/X-hold/bias/result values cannot publish before complete reload/CLEAR and valid sequencing.

checked_invariants.name: output_backpressure_and_fault
checked_invariants.result: out_pos and result payload hold without ready. Illegal accepted event suppresses normal state progress and success. If a block is already published, only output handshakes advance it under fault, preserving remaining block payload.

checked_invariants.name: completion_entry_barrier
checked_invariants.result: Ingress is closed whenever final result is published and during done pulse. A previously accepted illegal event retires before success; held next BEGIN can handshake only after final output and done boundary clear.

test_observations.result: Passive RAM/owner checks; blocked output payload stability; final-output invalid/pending fault/next BEGIN scenarios at both latencies; five reset phases at both latencies; continuous cold parameter task; actual RTL mutation run definitions.
Raw48 trace is independently compared with dense X@W and frozen numeric reference for stream=None. Directed custom streams skip raw trace checks but still compare full public Y/flags/task/index/last.

Current six mutation classes cover k63 loss,unsigned multiply,g tag mix,index corruption,early done,and advancing output without credit. Compiler-success condition is explicitly required before counting detection.

suggested_additional_mutations.name: MUT_X_HOLD_STALE
suggested_additional_mutations.change: Update x_hold only at returned g1 instead of g0 while leaving multiplier selection unchanged.
suggested_additional_mutations.expected_detection: Use varying k signed random inputs at L1/L2; g1 uses previous-k or uninitialized hold; independent output/raw48 scoreboard must reject.

suggested_additional_mutations.name: MUT_MASK_LEAK
suggested_additional_mutations.change: Quantize/drain PM rows instead of effective_rows in tail block.
suggested_additional_mutations.expected_detection: M3 or M99 PM4 yields excess/out-of-range/unknown outputs; output-count/index scoreboard must reject.

suggested_additional_mutations.name: MUT_FLUSH_EARLY_CONTEXT
suggested_additional_mutations.change: Exit FLUSH after k62/g3 retirement rather than k63/g3.
suggested_additional_mutations.expected_detection: k63-only vector makes g0 epilogue sample race k63 retirement; raw48 or output scoreboard must reject at both latencies.

suggested_additional_mutations.name: MUT_RESPONSE_OWNER
suggested_additional_mutations.change: Corrupt tagged row or tile identity while preserving arithmetic.
suggested_additional_mutations.expected_detection: PIPE_RESPONSE_OWNER passive assertion rejects actual compiled mutant; useful ownership-invariant proof rather than numerical proof.

boundaries: No official library STA/area/power acceptance inferred.
No all36 final-source completion asserted by this reviewer.
Fault recovery requires public reset; source does not promise automatic restart after fault.
SoC/firmware extension review follows separately in this report.

findings.issue: MMIO exposes input queue capacity and a core-ingress acceptance counter, but not a COMMIT-capture count or independent actual event-retirement count.
findings.consequence: Software and acceptance evidence cannot directly distinguish captured event, core acceptance and event retirement, although those are three separate lifecycle boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Name the existing counter core_accepts; expose independent capture and retirement counts or provide an explicitly bound passive TB trace. Define final-output queued event ownership clearly.

findings.issue: Adapter permits one captured event while final Y holds core ingress closed. The existing directed test queues BEGIN. An illegal queued op can be captured before final POP but reach core only after old core_done.
findings.consequence: If COMMIT response were described as old-task acceptance, sticky done could precede a previously captured illegal event fault. Under the explicit capture-only/next-task rule this can be legal; current public contract must make that distinction.
findings.recommendation: Document capture -> core acceptance -> retirement; add final-held illegal COMMIT and next BEGIN cases, checking exactly which task owns each captured event. Do not relabel core ingress acceptance as MMIO capture.

findings.issue: Directed adapter test fixes rsp_ready=1 and currently omits response backpressure, partial write mask, out-of-window/misaligned address, and fault while a result is retained.
findings.consequence: Source reasoning supports response stability and fault behavior, but these bus boundary claims lack direct compiled runtime evidence in this TB.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded public-port sequences with rsp_ready low across response payload/error, full queue rejection, fault/reset, and ensure no extra POP/COMMIT side effect.

findings.issue: Current CPU negatives cover an unsuccessful red-stub return and deliberately wrong expected output, but no otherwise-successful CPU path that skips the final Y/flag write or signals completion early.
findings.consequence: TB has explicit counters/responses/final SRAM checks that should reject such failures, but the requested false-CPU-done/last-write boundary mutation has not been demonstrated by these controls.
findings.recommendation: Compile a controlled driver/TB variant that omits final store or finishes early with nominal success magic; require intended coverage/missing-index failure and nonzero simulator exit.

checked_invariants.name: nonblocking_MMIO_capacity
checked_invariants.result: ICB command readiness depends only on outstanding response; queue-full COMMIT and empty POP return a bounded error response rather than blocking on core/result capacity.

checked_invariants.name: response_hold
checked_invariants.result: While rsp_valid and not rsp_ready, no further command fires and no response payload/error write occurs; synchronous source reasoning supports stable response.

checked_invariants.name: captured_event_payload
checked_invariants.result: Meta/task/position/data are copied to separate event registers on COMMIT, so later staging-register writes do not corrupt a pending event. No simultaneous dequeue/enqueue replacement is attempted; full event remains rejected.

checked_invariants.name: atomic_result_peek_POP
checked_invariants.result: Result index/data/flags/task are read while frontend owns and holds current output. Only explicit successful POP advances output; C driver checks identity/unique index/last, stores Y and flags by index, fences, then POPs.

checked_invariants.name: real_CPU_and_no_oracle_injection
checked_invariants.result: Actual frozen public E203 CPU and compiled C firmware are instantiated. Shared fixture contains input/weight/bias descriptors and poisoned Y/flag destinations; expected Y/flags remain separate TB-only arrays.

checked_invariants.name: shared_SRAM_indexed_writeback
checked_invariants.result: Every actual indexed output/flag store checks address/mask/expected data and uniqueness. Final shared RAM content is independently read back after CPU exit response; tile-order outputs need not be row-order.

checked_invariants.name: final_shared_response_before_system_done
checked_invariants.result: Output/flag transactions have pending ownership until shared response handshake; phase finish requires last response; system_done is raised only at terminal store response, with complete store/response/pop/start/task totals. The current source does not substitute core_done for system_done.

checked_invariants.name: two_task_memory_layout
checked_invariants.result: At M99/N256 and TASKS2, X/W/b/Y/flags regions remain within each 0x40000-byte bank and the total512KiB SRAM. Driver column-major packed W index matches Wq_packed source.

checked_invariants.name: fault_and_reset
checked_invariants.result: Reset clears response, event queue, sticky done and ownership counters; core receives same reset. Fault is visible in status and prevents COMMIT; POP remains available for published fault-held block.

existing_evidence_observed.observed: E203_REVD_PASS; two cold tasks;96 Y and96 flag writes;96/96 responses;2 starts;96 pops. This is historical evidence and final-source freshness must still be checked.
REVD_SOC_ADAPTER_PASS checks=22; queued-BEGIN/full-event rejection and reset were actually compiled/run by the main lane.
